claim.text:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), (0 : ℝ) ≤ f n) →
    (∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s) →
      (∃ (G : ℂ → ℂ),
          ContinuousOn G {s : ℂ | (1 : ℝ) ≤ s.re} ∧
            ∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → G s = LSeries (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s - (↑A : ℂ) / (s - (1 : ℂ))) →
        ∃ (K₀ : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (K : ℝ),
          (0 : ℝ) < c ∧
            (∀ (u : ℝ), (0 : ℝ) ≤ K₀ u) ∧
              (∀ (u : ℝ), (-2 : ℝ) ≤ u → u ≤ (0 : ℝ) → c ≤ K₀ u) ∧
                ∀ (X : ℝ),
                  (1 : ℝ) ≤ X →
                    (Summable fun (n : ℕ) => f n * K₀ (Real.log ((↑n : ℝ) / X)) / (↑n : ℝ)) ∧
                      ∑' (n : ℕ), f n * K₀ (Real.log ((↑n : ℝ) / X)) / (↑n : ℝ) ≤ K

      (∃ (G : ℂ → ℂ),
          ContinuousOn G {s : ℂ | (1 : ℝ) ≤ s.re} ∧
            ∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → G s = LSeries (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s - (↑A : ℂ) / (s - (1 : ℂ))) →
        ∃ (C : ℝ), ∀ (N : ℕ), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n ≤ C * (↑N : ℝ)

mathlib.doc: `LSeriesSummable f s` indicates that the L-series of `f` converges absolutely at `s`.
mathlib.name: LSeriesSummable

mathlib.doc: A function between topological spaces is continuous on a subset `s` when it's continuous at every point of `s` within `s`.
mathlib.name: ContinuousOn

mathlib.doc: The value of the L-series of the sequence `f` at the point `s` if it converges absolutely there, and `0` otherwise.
mathlib.name: LSeries

mathlib.doc: `Summable f` means that `f` has some (infinite) sum with respect to `L`.
mathlib.name: Summable

mathlib.doc: The real logarithm function, equal to the inverse of the exponential for `x > 0`, to `log |x|` for `x < 0`, and to `0` for `0`.
mathlib.name: Real.log
